name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source web application firewall built on NGINX, with ModSecurity, bot protection and a web UI to manage the services it reverse proxies.

alerts.message: Sign in to the web UI as ADMIN_USERNAME (admin) with the generated ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment variables. The password must keep an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a digit and a symbol. Change it by editing ADMIN_PASSWORD and redeploying: it is re-applied on every start, so a password changed only in the UI is reset.

To protect another app, point an extra domain at this service on port 8080, then add a service with that server name in the UI that reverse proxies to an address of the app this container can reach. HTTPS is terminated in front of BunkerWeb: leave Let's Encrypt and HTTP to HTTPS redirects disabled.
